# Generated — do not edit

These files are compiled from `app/*.jsx` by `npm run build`.

The browser no longer carries a JSX compiler, so this directory IS what ships.
**After editing any `.jsx`, run `npm run build`** or the site serves stale code.

    npm run build     # compile app/*.jsx -> app/build/*.js
    npm run watch     # rebuild on save while developing
    npm run verify    # fail if app/build is out of sync with the sources
